tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /smon lam gyi rgyal po bzang po spyod pa'i don 'grel khog phug bde ba can du bgrod pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med mgon po rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /gang gi zhing der rang gzhan ma lus pa/ /skye phyir smon lam don 'grel 'dir spel lo/ /zhes rgya gar saṃskri ta'i skad kyis skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa la mchod par brjod cing / bod skad tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas rtsom par dam bcas nas/ 'dir smon lam gyi rgyal po bzang po spyod pa'i don 'grel khog phug bde ba can du bgrod pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba 'di bshad par bya ste/ de yang gang gis dad pas nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum du btab na/ rab tshe 'di/ 'bring 'chi kha/ tha ma la yang bar dor bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam sangs rgyas phal po che las gsungs pa'i don pha rol tu phyin pa bcur bsdus nas ston pa'i smon lam 'di 'chad pa la spyi don gsum ste/ smon lam 'grub pa'i rgyu yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ smon lam nyid rgyas par bshad pa/ bsngo ba'i sgo nas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag la sogs pa yan lag bdun po/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /zhes pa nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan no/ /spyi don gnyis pa smon lam nyid rgyas par bshad pa la/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu yod pa las/ dang po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la/ thog mar zang zing gi sbyin pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i smon lam ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /zhes pa nas/ bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas byon/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i smon lam ni/

phyogs bcu'i zhing gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgo nas chos don grub cing skye ba dran pa'i smon lam ni/ 'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni/ /zhes pa nas/ 'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par gyur/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba rnams rab tu 'byung zhing tshul khrims dri ma med par smon pa ni/ tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na/ /zhes pa nas/ rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims kyi sgo nas 'gro ba so so'i skad du chos ston pa'i smon lam ni/ lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /ces pa nas/ thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ dge ba chos bsdus kyi tshul khrims kyi sgo nas yon tan thams cad chags thogs med par bsdus pa'i smon lam ni/ des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson te/ /zhes pa nas/ nyi zla nam mkha' thogs pa med par spyod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sdug bsngal gyi bzod pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad ngan song las grol nas bde ba la 'god pa'i smon lam ni/ zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /zhes pa nas/ 'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i sgo nas byang chub kyi spyod pa la slob cing spyod pa gzhan la ston pa la bskal pa'i bar du mi skyo bar smon pa ni/ byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / zhes pa nas/ ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ chos la nges par rtog pa'i bzod pa'i sgo nas grogs dam pa dang 'phrad cing de dang 'grogs par smon pa ni/

bdag gi spyod dang mtshungs par gang spyod pa/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung / /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ bsam pa go cha'i brtson 'grus kyi sgo nas rgyal ba sras bcas bskal pa'i bar du mngon sum du blta zhing de la mchod pa'i smon lam ni/ sangs rgyas sras kyis skor ba'i mgon po rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ sbyor ba sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 'dzin zhing yon tan gyi gter du gyur pa'i smon lam ni/ rgyal ba rnams kyis dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /zhes pa nas/ yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ lnga pa bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ zhi gnas kyi bsam gtan gyis gsal stong mngon du byed pa'i smon lam ni/ rdul cig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub spyod pa spyod cing blta bar bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ lhag mthong gi bsam gtan gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las tshad med pa bzhi la 'jug pa'i smon lam ni/ de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang / /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas gsung la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa la 'jug pa'i smon lam ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dag /ces pa nas/ skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ ji lta ba rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i smon lam ni/ gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /ces pa nas/ sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam thar stobs kyis 'jug /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan to/

/bdun pa thabs kyis pha rol tu phyin pa la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pa'i thabs mkhas kyi smon lam ni/ gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod pa/ /zhes pa nas/ rgyal ba kun gyi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi smon lam ni/ gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ mgon po kun gyis drung du bdag mchi 'o/ /zhes bar gyis bstan to/ /brgyad pa stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i stobs kyi smon lam ni/ kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang / /zhes pa nas/ byang chub stobs rnams yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces pa'i bar gyi bstan/ spang bya zad pa'i stobs kyi smon lam ni/ las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag byed cing / /zhes pa nas/ bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyis/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ dgu pa smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ zhing dag par smon pa'i smon lam/ sems can grol bar smon pa'i smon lam/ dam pa'i chos thob par smon pa'i smon lam gsum ni rim pa bzhin/ zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /zhes pa dang / sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par sgrol/ /zhes pa dang / chos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing / /zhes pas bstan/ ye shes rtogs par smon pa dang / spyod pa rnam par dag par smon pa dang / smon lam yongs su rdzogs par smon pa gsum ni rim pa bzhin/ ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed/ /ces pa dang / spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /zhes pa dang / smon lam rgya mtsho rab tu rdzogs par byed/ /ces pas bstan/ sangs rgyas rnams bskal pa rgya mtshor mchod par smon pa'i smon lam ni/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing / /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi skyo spyod par bgyi/ /zhes pas bstan no/ /bcu pa ye shes gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i smon lam ni/

gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ de kun bdag gis ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan to/ /spyi don gsum pa bsngo ba'i sgo nas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa la/ smon lam de rnams bsngo ba dang / bsngo ba'i phan yon bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la dge ba rnam dag kun tu bzang po dang mthun par bsngo ba ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo ba/ /zhes pa nas/ de 'drar bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa spyod pa rnam dag 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang mthun par bsngo ba ni/ kun nas dge ba bzang po spyad pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag 'khrul ba thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa smon lam rnam dag sems can gyi khams dang mthun par bsngo ba ni/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ci tsam par/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan to/ /gnyis pa bsngo ba'i phan yon bshad pa la/ phan yon dngos dang / phan yon de yang bsngo ba gnyis las/ dang po phan yon dngos la/ smon lam 'di la dad cing thos pa'i phan yon/ smon lam 'di bton pa'i phan yon/ smon lam 'di 'chang zhing gzhan la bstan pa'i phan yon dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po smon lam 'di la dad cing thos pa'i phan yon ni/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa/ /zhes pa nas/ bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa smon lam 'di bton pa'i phan yon la/ grogs ngan pa spong pa'i phan yon/ bde ba can du skye ba'i phan yon/ kun tu bzang po dang 'dra ba'i phan yon rnams ni/ gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pas/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag ring por mi thogs de bzhin 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gzhan yang las kyi sgrib pa 'dag pa'i phan yon ni/ mtshams med lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur/

/zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ yang yon tan thos pa dang / bdud kyis mi thub pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad 'grub pa la sogs pa'i phan yon ni/ ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang / /zhes pa nas/ bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thams cad btul/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa smon lam 'di bcangs shing gzhan la bstan pa'i phan yon ni/ gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'di/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub mchog la som nyid ma byed cig /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa phan yon de yang bsngo ba la/ sangs rgyas dngos dang thun mong du bsngo ba/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams dang thun mong du bsngo ba/ rang don bde ba can du bsngo ba/ gzhan don sprul pas sems can thams cad bde ba can du 'dren zhing 'od dpag med kyi lung bstan thob par bsngo ba dang bzhi yod pa las/ dang po sangs rgyas dngos dang thun mong du bsngo ba ni/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams dang thun mong du bsngo ba ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /zhes pa nas/ bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa rang don bde ba can du bsngo ba ni/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /zhes pa nas/ lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bzhi pa gzhan don sprul pas sems can thams cad bde ba can du 'dren cing 'od dpag med kyi lung bstan thob par bsngo ba ni/ der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas/ /zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan pa yin no/ /smon lam rgyal po sogs tshig rkang bzhi ni lo tsā bas bcug pa yin par yig cha rnying ma rnams las bshad do/ /de rnams kyis smon lam gyi rgyal po bzang po spyod pa'i don 'grel khog phub bde ba can du bgrod pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos ma lus pa bshad zin to/

/'dir smras pa/ bstan dang 'gro don bsgrub blo'i rnam g.yengs kyi/ /sems dang zab mo'i nyams len skad cig tsam/ /'dre bar nus min rang gi rnam thar la/ /khrel ba'i blo yis smon lam bzang po la/ /rten nas phyi ma dag pa'i zhing gi mchog /bde ba can du skyes nas rang gzhan kun/ /'bad pa med par don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i/ /go 'phang thob phyir don 'grel 'di brtsams so/ /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba'i/ /za nyal 'chag gi ngang nas bstan 'gro'i don/ /'grub par re ba'i snyoms las can de'o/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don kun/ /lhun gyis grub nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe/ /thogs med bde ba can du skye bar shog /don 'grel khog phub 'di yi yi ge pa/ /rab 'byams smra ba rgya mtsho'i mtha' can dang / /shab stod skyes pa'i don grub ming can gyis/ /gus spro'i ngang nas bgyis 'di dge gyur cig /bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig 'di bgyis dge bas bdag cag dpon slob phyi ma bde ba can du nges par skye bar gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ smon lam gyi rgyal po bzang po spyod pa'i don 'grel khog phub bde ba can du bgrod pa'i lam bzang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
